sources.snippet: EdgeTAM is an on-device executable variant of the SAM 2 for promptable segmentation and tracking in videos. It runs 22× faster than SAM 2 and achieves 16 FPS on iPhone 15 Pro Max without quantization. sources.title: EdgeTAM-hf: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview EdgeTAM-hf is an on-device segmentation model that brings the capabilities of SAM 2 to mobile devices by running 22× faster than the original while achieving 16 FPS on iPhone 15 Pro Max without quantization. sources.snippet: EdgeTAM is an efficient adaptation of SAM 2 that introduces a 2D Spatial Perceiver architecture to optimize memory attention mechanisms for real-time video segmentation on mobile devices.
